eventDetail.scope: CITCE 2026 will provide a professional academic platform for global researchers, engineers, and practitioners to share cutting-edge advances and discuss key technical challenges in computer science, IoT, and control engineering. The conference will cover core topics including machine learning algorithms and applications, deep learning and neural network design, natural language processing and understanding, computer vision and image recognition, IoT architecture and system design, wireless sensor networks, IoT data security and privacy protection, intelligent control theory, automatic control system design, industrial control automation, and complex system control and optimization. With keynote speeches, technical seminars, and academic exchanges, it will promote international academic cooperation, resolve practical technical issues, and advance the innovative development and industrial application of related technologies.
